items.text: Incorporated 3 decisions from round 003 into the conclusion. (1) Mobile interaction model: confirmed adaptive layout with full graph canvas, simplified nodes, and bottom sheet inspector — Finding 9 was already aligned, no changes needed. (2) URL strategy: changed from preserved legacy paths to new /graph?lens=X&select=kind/name scheme with 301 redirects — Finding 7, Summary, Limitations, and Actions 2/5 updated accordingly. (3) Operations real-time strategy: changed from polling (5s/30s intervals) to SSE push-based updates — Finding 5, Finding 8, Summary, Limitations, and Actions 1/4 updated accordingly.

Remaining gap: testability score stays at 2/3. Full verification of graph performance thresholds, SSE reliability, mobile node caps, and initiative clustering UX requires building the actual graph and testing with real data. This is inherent to the research-vs-execution boundary — the execute items are designed to close this gap.

All 6 spec deliverables are covered: (1) graph workspace architecture — Findings 1-2 + shell IA in Finding 7/9, (2) canonical node/edge contract — Finding 3, (3) lens definitions and inspector action model — Findings 5-6, (4) rollout and cleanup plan — Finding 7 migration mapping, (5) recommended execute-item decomposition — Actions 1-6, (6) performance constraints and anti-chaos guardrails — Finding 8. The conclusion stands alone as the complete research contract.
